[Verse 1: raspy male voice, storytelling]
Danny couldn't walk since the accident in June
We heard a man was in town, said he might be leaving soon
House was packed out to the street, couldn't get in the door
So Marcus looked at me and said, "What's a roof for?"

[Chorus: gang vocals, full band, anthemic]
We cut a hole in the roof
Four friends and a rope and a mat
Dust coming down on the good people's heads
We weren't sorry about that
When a friend can't get there on his own
You carry him, you make a way through
You don't knock, you don't wait, you don't ask
You cut a hole in the roof

[Verse 2: voice lower, band holding back]
We lowered him down in the middle of the room
Right at the feet of Jesus, in the quiet, in the gloom
He looked up at us four, sweating, through the beams
Then down at Danny, smiling: "Son, you're forgiven. You're free."

[Chorus: gang vocals, full band, anthemic]

Dust coming down on the good people's heads

When a friend can't get there on his own

You cut a hole in the roof

And I've had friends on the rope. Amen.

Four friends and a rope and a mat
If you can't get to him on your own
We will carry you. Count on that.

You cut a hole in the roof
